figures.caption: The seed is in board A. Rendering has not begun.
figures.alt: Four annotated details before the first render. Current pointer s0 addresses board A at hexadecimal 10010148, destination s1 addresses board B at 100101b0, limit s2 is two and counter s3 is zero. The published generation is still minus one and the bitmap is entirely black.

figures.caption: Generation zero is published before the first update.
figures.alt: Four annotated details at generation ready with the native condition s3 equals zero. Board A is current, board B is destination, requested updates are two and the current counter is zero. The memory publication is zero. The bitmap shows white cells two three, three three and four three.

figures.caption: Generation one is published from board B after a complete synchronous update.
figures.alt: Four annotated details at generation ready with the native condition s3 equals one. Current s0 now addresses board B and destination s1 addresses board A. Counter s3 and the memory publication both contain one, while the requested update count remains two. The bitmap shows white cells three two, three three and three four.

figures.caption: Generation two returns to board A and repeats the seed pattern.
figures.alt: Four annotated details at generation ready with native condition s3 equals two. Current pointer s0 again selects board A and destination s1 selects board B. Both the counter and the published generation are two. The framebuffer is horizontal again, with live cells two three, three three and four three.
